environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in us-east-1 VPC. S3 bucket 'tenant-uploads' configured with public access enabled (Block Public Access OFF), bucket policy allows s3:PutObjectAcl. CloudFront distribution serves S3 bucket directly with no origin restrictions. No content-type validation at any layer. Task role has s3:PutObject and s3:PutObjectAcl permissions on the bucket.

config.s3_bucket_policy: allows public GetObject on tenants/* prefix
